title: The Essive-Formal Suffix: -ként (As / In the Capacity Of)

sections.content:
The essive-formal case suffix is **-ként**. It means **'as'**, **'in the role of'**, or **'in the capacity of'**.

A great benefit for learners: **-ként is invariant**! It does NOT follow vowel harmony, and it attaches directly to nouns with front or back vowels without changing:
- *tanár* (teacher) → *tanárként* (as a teacher)
- *orvos* (doctor) → *orvosként* (as a doctor)
- *mérnök* (engineer) → *mérnökként* (as an engineer)
- *diák* (student) → *diákként* (as a student)

items.english: I have been working as a teacher in Budapest for five years.
As a doctor, it is my duty to help.
